items.label: Second-hand bed
items.reason: You need somewhere to sleep before you need anything else.

items.label: Flat-pack desk
items.reason: Came with the apartment. One leg wobbles.

items.label: Old work laptop
items.reason: The only thing I actually own.

items.label: Kitchen chair
items.reason: Not a desk chair. My back already knows.

items.label: Corner lamp
items.reason: The ceiling light is too white to think under.

items.label: Kitchen counter
items.reason: Came with the apartment. Chipped at one corner.

items.label: Wall clock
items.reason: Left by whoever lived here before. It runs four minutes fast and I have not fixed it.

items.label: Moving boxes
items.reason: Everything I own arrived in these. I unpacked them on day nine.

items.label: A stack of books
items.reason: Four of them. I have read one and moved the other three twice.

items.label: The good mug
items.reason: Chipped on the handle. I would be annoyed if it broke, which tells me something.

items.label: Second-hand office chair
items.reason: My back had been filing complaints for five days and I finally read one.

items.label: Small pixel art print
items.reason: The wall was doing nothing and I wanted to be reminded what restraint looks like.

items.label: Small plant, species unknown
items.reason: A room with something alive in it is a different room.

items.label: Second-hand rug
items.reason: The floor was loud and cold and I was tired of hearing my own chair.

items.label: Small coffee machine
items.reason: Ten days of bad instant coffee stopped being a fact of life and became a thing I could fix.

items.label: Hand-me-down monitor
items.reason: The office was throwing it out. Asking for it took longer than carrying it home did.

items.label: Shelf the last tenant left
items.reason: It has been in the hallway store since I moved in. I finally carried it up, and the books came off the floor.

items.label: Clip-on desk lamp
items.reason: Came home in the same box as the monitor. The office was throwing both out.

items.label: Spare office keyboard
items.reason: Also from that box. The laptop keys had started to feel like an apology.
